title: Urban transit network design using spanning tree: A case study of Canberra transit network
summary: Transit network design plays an important role in public transport. With the simplicity of spanning tree, this paper adopts the concept of spanning tree to help (re-)design a public transit network that addresses passenger utility by minimizing the total passenger-kilometers, which can be formulated as a mixed-integer optimization model. However, searching for an optimal minimum passenger-kilometer spanning tree is intractable for a large network.
